NextFAQ

Questions clients ask

What can you help me with?

Inbox and calendar management, data entry, social media support, Canva design, presentations, research and spreadsheet upkeep. If your task is not listed, send it over and I will tell you honestly whether I can help.

How do we get started?

Send a message or book a discovery call. We talk through your tasks and goals, I send a written scope and quote, and work begins once you approve it.

Which tools do you use?

Canva Pro, Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets and Gmail), Microsoft Office, Notion, Trello, ChatGPT and CapCut. I can also learn the tools your team already uses.

How is pricing decided?

Each project or ongoing arrangement is quoted by scope, so there is no fixed price list. You receive the full quote in writing before any work starts.

How will we communicate?

By email or phone, whichever you prefer, and you can also message me on Facebook. I send progress updates so you always know where your tasks stand.

Do you have client testimonials yet?

Not yet. I am building my client portfolio, so the projects shown are labeled as samples. Real client feedback will be added as it comes in.
